results.title: Signed writes break on a same-origin 301/302/303: the redirect rewrites POST to a bodyless GET but keeps the signature headers
results.author: beardthelion
results.body_snippet: Both signing clients follow a same-origin 301, 302 or 303 by rewriting the request to a bodyless GET while keeping the RFC 9421 headers attached. The signature then describes a POST and a body that no longer exist, so the node rejects the write with 401 `invalid_signature`. Only 307 and 308 preserve the method. results.title: [Bounty Proposal] ttnn.sampling: temperature applied before max-subtraction makes sampled probabilities depend on logit magnitude
results.author: Aqil-Ahmad
results.body_snippet: **Description:** With temperature != 1, `ttnn.sampling` doesn’t sample from `softmax(logits / T)` when the logits are large. Shifting all logits by a constant changes the output distribution, sometimes by a lot. In `sampling.cpp`, the kernel multiplies the raw values by `1/T` (`mul_block_bcast_scalar_inplace`) and packs the result back to bf16. Only after that does it reduce the max and do `sub_exp`.
